ownerDecisions.OD-1: V x A values may flag a conflict, never prove YES or NO
ownerDecisions.OD-2: an allocation proves individual-port capability only for its exact ports and operating condition; never another configuration
ownerDecisions.OD-3: NO needs all applicable authoritative evidence to rule the capability out; evidence that could support it -> UNKNOWN
ownerDecisions.OD-4: no PD version inferred from another
ownerDecisions.OD-6: "C1/C2" = each port only where the wording clearly supports it (spec-table output lines); never simultaneous
ownerDecisions.OD-A: 0152 / 85779 NO only because the explicit "Multi-port Total Output: 20W" rules out 2 x 20W (2026-10-14)
ownerDecisions.OD-B: 0442 and its 27 hub siblings stay UNKNOWN: "not for Charging" is advisory, not an explicit PD negative (2026-10-14)
ownerDecisions.OD-C: a port's own V x A spec line may flag a contradiction with a higher prose wattage claim (C-PORT); calculated wattage never establishes YES or NO (2026-10-14)
ownerDecisions.OD-D: C-RECORD accepted for verified mixed-product records, hand review only, initially 35525B and 55910B; affected claims fail closed (2026-10-14)
ownerDecisions.OD-E: the 12 verified 55W rows of 75701B / 75701C / 85301B keep the exact Xiaomi-only condition as a caveat (2026-10-14)
ownerDecisions.OD-I: the D2 condition is attached to the 55W statements, so a conditional YES never becomes unconditional (2026-10-14)
ownerDecisions.OD-J: narrow P2M1.18 exception: unversioned protocol YES on a pinned C-RECORD SKU only when every side states the protocol (0778) (2026-10-14)

method.inventory: Independent reference extractor (Python, outside the repo; does not import js/vero-evidence.js) over the PUBLISHED (not disabled) catalogue records of the power families (charger, power_bank, charging_cable, hub_dock) plus 3 power-bearing records of other families; labelled spec lines (incl. label-only bullets with their unbulleted continuation lines) classified by rule; prose UNSCOPED unless a safe rule applies (descriptor equal to the name rating, explicit total phrase, PD tokens, cable-family rating, accessory / recommendation / input clauses); 187 statement adjudications and 2 record conflicts by hand, recorded in each statement's "adjudicated" field. "hand-reviewed" records had every statement reviewed by hand; "rule-only" records were classified by rule only and checked by an automated coverage audit (every line carrying a wattage, V / A value or PD token is covered by a statement or is a listed, reviewed exclusion); not every rule-only statement was reviewed by hand.
method.oracle: Core rows hand-labelled by the main session from the catalogue text (design §5 + OD clarifications); generated rows from an independent Python reference decision function over the reviewed inventory (TOTAL, NAMED_PORT, ANY_SINGLE, CABLE, PROTOCOL). The hand labels were cross-checked against the reference where both apply (0 disagreements after inventory fixes). Labels never come from js/vero-evidence.js output.
method.current: "current" = outcome of the provisional-baseline tree (real planner + classify(); YES = LOCAL/local_confirmed, NO = LOCAL/local_contradicted, UNKNOWN = EVIDENCE, CLARIFY, LOCAL:<reason> = no evidence decision). Pinned: any change in a later milestone must be listed and reviewed (design §7 M-6).

conflictKinds.C-TOTAL: two total-scope values disagree (decision-capable values or a DERIVED veto value)
conflictKinds.C-PORT: two values for the same port / cable member disagree
conflictKinds.C-PORT-OVER-TOTAL: a port value above an explicit total
conflictKinds.C-PD-WATT: a PD-labelled port figure disagrees with the port value
conflictKinds.C-ALLOC-SUM: an allocation sum above an explicit total
conflictKinds.C-WIRELESS: two wireless values for the same device class disagree
conflictKinds.C-INPUT: two input values for the same member disagree
conflictKinds.C-RECORD: record-level inconsistency: the name / prose describe another product than the spec lines; owner-acknowledged 2026-10-14 (OD-D), hand review only, pinned SKUs 35525B and 55910B; every power ask fails closed (UNKNOWN); a protocol ask is YES only when every side states it
